newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, buoyed by CBOT wheat.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, buoyed by CBOT wheat.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed and above new contract lows set during the session thanks to spillover support from CBOT wheat, traders said.
"We stayed pretty quiet all day and then we rallied behind Chicago," one trader said.

But hedge-pressure in MGE spring wheat limited the kinds of gains seen in KCBT and CBOT wheat, which gained on strong commercial stopping of deliveries posted Wednesday and on signs the market was technically oversold.
MGE spring wheat closed two cents per bushel lower to 3-1/2 cents higher, with Sept down one cent at $4.26.
Dec gained three cents to close at $4.10-1/2. Earlier, MGE Dec spring wheat hit a new contract low of $4.03 per bushel -- down 4-1/2 cents on the session.

Benson-Quinn reportedly sold 1.5 million Dec bushels. Atwood-Peavey and CIS each bought at least one million Dec, traders said. Atwood-Peavey also bear-spread one million March/Dec at 2-3/4 cents per bushel.
MGE estimated Wednesday's spring wheat volume at 26.262 million bushels, up from Tuesday's volume of 17.545 million.
MGE barley closed unchanged, with Dec at $7.17 per hundredweight.
